notes.title: Launch Day Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Fellow Explorers[/h2]

First off I want to say thank you to everyone that has purchased The Lost Dog.

Secondly I want to apologise for the issues many of you have been having. I've been working flat out today trying to launch the game and also patch these issues. I've released two small patches today which should fix the issues I am aware of, but many I still not be so please drop a comment on this post or give me an email if you find anything else!

[i]Thank you for you patience and being part of the The Lost Dog Story,
Tom[/i]


[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed Issue where cursor was not appearing at the ending of the intro scene
[*]Fixed clipping issues in Chapter 1 of the game, where the player would  fall off the terrain. Majority of these should be fixed but small areas may remain.
[*]Fixed audio mix issues
[*]Altered the first level based on feedback and reviews to improve enjoy-ability.
[*]Added markings onto the quests on Chapter 2
[*]Adjusted the controls popup which was appearing over the intro sequence.
[*]Other small bugs
[/list]
